tools.name: search_store
tools.description: Find what Xevol's store offers, the same listings xevol.com shows: ready-made jobs, products, services and screens from Xevol and other publishers. Pass optional words (q; every word must appear in the card), app, kind or goodFor (a kind of customer), or nothing with limit 200 for the whole store, a

tools.name: get_store_item
tools.description: One store item by its publisher name and slug (both from search_store): what it does, what it needs, what an install would touch, its settings and its link. It says nothing about any Workspace; what a Workspace still needs before an install is on the signed-in server, https://xevol.com/api/mcp. Free
